questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Tabcorp and/or BetMakers.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if there are not many alternatives to Tabcorp and/or BetMakers, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Which wagering technology service provider(s) do you currently use, and for what services?
Identify who you consider to be alternative wagering technology service providers, and their relative competitive strength. Please outline any challenges in switching providers.
Identify who you consider to be your closest competitors in the provision of the wagering services you provide.
Please outline what wagering technology services you supply, and who you consider are your main competitors for each service.
In each wagering technology services you provide, what do you consider your competitive strengths and weaknesses are, compared to BetMakers.
